notes: Nodes form a tree. A node in stock satisfies a requirement for itself or any ancestor.
kind=category nodes group the tree for classification and UI. They cannot be stocked or required.
aliases are lowercase strings that map a preprocessed core directly to the node without classification.
staple=true nodes are stocked by default in the app.
Product names appear only where the product has no generic style name and is called for by name.
fallback on a root names the node an item resolves to when the classifier is confident about the family but not the specific node. Such requirements are marked substitute=true.
